Name: Buz
Summary: Buz was a son of Nahor and Milcah, and the brother of Uz.
KeyStory: Buz is named among the eight children Milcah bore to Nahor in the family record after the binding of Isaac.
RelatedPeople: Nahor, Brother of Abraham; Milcah; Uz, Son of Nahor
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
